selector.title: Data Ownership Policy
selector.description: Choose who owns the data created by agents in your organization.

agency.title: Agency-Owned
agency.description: All data belongs to the agency. When agents leave, their data stays with the organization.

agent.title: Agent-Owned
agent.description: Agents own the data they create. When agents leave, their data migrates to their personal workspace.

banner.title: Data Ownership Policy Required
banner.description: Your organization hasn't set a data ownership policy yet. This determines what happens to data when agents leave.
banner.askAdmin: Ask your admin to set the data ownership policy.

invitation.title: Data Ownership Consent
invitation.description: Before joining {orgName}, please review and accept the data ownership policy.
invitation.policyDescription_AGENCY: This organization uses an Agency-Owned data policy. All data you create will belong to the organization.
invitation.policyDescription_AGENT: This organization uses an Agent-Owned data policy. Data you create will remain yours if you leave.
invitation.checkboxLabel: I understand and accept this data ownership policy

policyChange.title: Policy Change — Consent Required
policyChange.description: {orgName} has changed its data ownership policy.
policyChange.newPolicy_AGENCY: The new policy is Agency-Owned. All new data you create will belong to the organization.
policyChange.newPolicy_AGENT: The new policy is Agent-Owned. New data you create will remain yours if you leave.
policyChange.note: Existing data follows the policy that was active when it was created.
policyChange.checkboxLabel: I understand and accept the new data ownership policy
policyChange.leaveWarning_AGENT: If you leave, your agent-owned data will be migrated to your personal workspace. Active deals will be cancelled.
policyChange.leaveWarning_AGENCY: If you leave, your data will remain with the organization.

settings.title: Data Ownership
settings.description_AGENCY: All data belongs to the agency. When agents depart, data stays with the organization.
settings.description_AGENT: Agents own the data they create. When agents depart, their data migrates to their personal workspace.
settings.changePolicyWarning: Changing the data ownership policy requires all agents to re-consent. Existing data follows the policy that was active when it was created (prospective-only).

consentRequired.title: Consent Required
consentRequired.description: The organization's data ownership policy has been updated. You must review and accept the new policy to continue.
